result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The full offline test suite (`mvn -q -o test`) passes. No existing test calls this query, and I didn't add one, so the Anna/Bob example isn't checked by a test.

The change is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. The count subquery now has `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the other cancelled-excluding queries use. I also updated the method's Javadoc to say cancelled orders are excluded. Reps with no purchase orders in the period still show 0, and the ordering is unchanged.
